items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: I don't remember the year, I don't remember the year now of Hans, I don't remember him

ctx.x: Okay, okay, when did you meet Slim? What was it?

I don't remember the year, I don't remember the year now of Hans, I don't remember him, but anyway, Slim came to me. I was living downtown on Utrip Street, and he had three pieces with him. Well, see, I had this band already with about six, seven pieces. So, I told him, I said, well, man, I said, I've got a good band. He said, man, I can improve your business, you know. I said, come over and hear me. I said, I went over, he's working over the river over here then, or the place over there, I can't think of the…
Do you know who the band was?
